Description: The Alzheimer Society of Ireland (ASI) invites tenders to this request for tenders from economic operators for the provision of the services as described in Appendix 1 to this RFT. In summary, the Services comprise: Suitably qualified and experienced firm to undertake comprehensive valuations of ASI’s property portfolio currently comprising of fourteen (14) properties located throughout the Republic of Ireland.
